# ZayPick — Full Site Reference for AI Assistants

> ZayPick (https://zaypick.vercel.app/) is a hand-picked Amazon deals site.
> It lists the best Amazon deals across Electronics, Fashion, Home, Beauty,
> Sports and Toys, with real prices, ratings and review counts. ZayPick does NOT
> sell or ship anything — every "Buy on Amazon" button goes to Amazon, where
> the purchase, shipping and returns are handled by Amazon.
> Contact: hello@zaypick.com
> Prices shown are as of 2026-11-23. Prices change on Amazon — always check
> the current price on Amazon before buying.
> Disclosure: As an Amazon Associate, ZayPick earns from qualifying
> purchases. This costs the buyer nothing extra.

## Frequently asked questions

- What is ZayPick? A hand-picked Amazon deals site. The ZayPick team finds
  well-reviewed Amazon products with real discounts and lists them in one place.
- Does ZayPick sell products? No. ZayPick does not sell, ship or handle
  returns. Clicking "Buy on Amazon" takes you to Amazon to complete the purchase.
- How do prices work? The price shown is the Amazon price as of 2026-11-23,
  with the old price where there is a real discount. Prices change on Amazon,
  so check the current price there before buying.
- Does ZayPick earn money? Yes — as an Amazon Associate, ZayPick earns from
  qualifying purchases, at no extra cost to the buyer.
- Who handles shipping and returns? Amazon does, under Amazon's own shipping
  and return policy. Prime eligibility is shown on Amazon.
- How are products chosen? Hand-picked by the ZayPick team: well-reviewed
  products (ratings and review counts are shown) with genuine discounts.
